evidence.r1: The planner, permit action and reservation platter are controls; the trail table and conditions have no glass.
evidence.r2: The permit platter stays below the trigger, and its actions use simple fills rather than another glass layer.
evidence.r3: One planner, one permit action and one temporary reservation platter carry the workflow.
evidence.r4: The planner and reservation platter share the same pale, frosted material appearance.
evidence.r5: No clear-glass surface is visible; the planner and permit platter are frosted.
evidence.r6: The open permit view retains the pink Check permit control while also showing the red Reserve action.
evidence.r7: The normal planner and permit platter visibly transmit softened mountain colours rather than a flat replacement fill.
evidence.r8: The planner and platter use fixed corner radii, while Check permit and Reserve are capsules.
evidence.r9: The permit-detail rows have rounded lower corners that do not follow the enclosing platter arcs.
evidence.r10: Check permit and the outlined Close action have capsule outlines.
evidence.r11: Trip settings share the planner background, while the permit action occupies a separate group.
evidence.r12: The planner and permit platter use text actions without separate icon buttons on their backgrounds.
evidence.r13: The planner material encloses the whole control group rather than individual text fields.
evidence.r14: The planner fields form one continuous surface, and the permit action is deliberately separated.
evidence.r15: The second and third screens show one soft top fade where trail and conditions content passes under the planner.
evidence.r16: Mountain imagery remains behind the floating controls even over the lower trail and conditions sections.
evidence.r17: The opening headline and body copy begin well below the planner and permit controls.
evidence.r18: The light planner is readable, but no dark appearance establishes the required contrast in both modes.
evidence.r19: The reduced-transparency planner stays readable, but increased contrast and reduced-motion behaviour are not shown.
evidence.r20: The mountain photograph reaches every window edge behind the floating planner.
evidence.r21: The opening text clears the controls, and the lower screens retain an extended mountain background with a soft content boundary.
evidence.r22: The lower screens add a persistent mountain-image strip and fade beneath the floating planner.
evidence.r23: The open reservation still does not show materialisation, morphing or pointer press feedback.
evidence.r24: Planner and permit labels are monochrome; trail warnings carry the content-layer colour.
evidence.r25: Dark planner and permit labels remain distinct from their pale mountain-tinted surfaces.
